segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Now, let's look at a 20th-century artist and teacher named Loïs Mailou Jones.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Loïs Mailou Jones was born in 1905 in the state of Massachusetts in the United States.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Early on, her parents recognized her creative talent and gave her a good start by making sure she had crayons, paper, and other supplies.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: As an adult, Jones took a sabbatical from her teaching job to study art in Paris in 1937.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: With the artistic communities and museums in Paris, it was a formative experience where Jones practiced painting landscapes and street scenes.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: She also learned more about Impressionism and other painting styles.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: You can see this influence in her 1940 oil painting called Indian Shops, which depicts a scene in Martha's Vineyard, a coastal town in Massachusetts where Jones had spent time as a child.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Indian Shops shows a pretty realistic and calm summer scene of small stores with vendors, the ocean, and the sky.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: The colors are warm and light.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: I appreciate the way it balances nature alongside human-made structures.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Now, later in her career, Jones produced more abstract work.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: One striking example of this is an oil and collage piece called Moon Masque from 1971.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: In Moon Masque, Jones connected with her own African heritage using vibrant colors and geometric shapes.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: It's an emotional work where she incorporated a replica of a white African mask that appears to be crying.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: It's surrounded by black profiles of faces looking left and right.
